newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jardine Fleming launches open Japanese unit trust.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Fleming launches open Japanese unit trust.

text.p: Jardine Fleming Investment Trust and Advisory Co (JFITAC) in Tokyo said a new open-ended investment trust, JF Mid-Smaller Co Open, attracted 21.8 billion yen before its launch on Thursday.

The unit trust will provide Japanese and other investors with the opportunity to benefit from the growth of medium and smaller sized companies as the Japanese economy recovers, Jardine Fleming said in a statement received in Hong Kong.

The new fund will be managed by a team of 10 investment managers based in Japan who visited over 1,000 companies last year, allowing them to identify companies with strong growth potential as yet unrecognized in stock market valuations, the company said.
"We continue to believe that Japan's economic recovery is underway," the investment managers said in a press release.
"This in tandem with the anticipated further weakness of the currency will lead to good corporate profit growth in the years ahead," they said.

JFITAC has US$6.2 billion under management, of which US$1.56 billion is managed on behalf of 18 Japanese investment trusts, which JFITAC said makes it the largest foreign manager of equity investments trusts in Japan.
